name: Admenta 10mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ADMENTA 10MG TABLET

What is Admenta 10mg Tablet?

Admenta 10mg Tablet contains Memantine, an NMDA receptor antagonist used to manage moderate to severe Alzheimer's disease. It works by regulating abnormal brain activity involved in memory and cognition impairment.

Memantine blocks overactivation of NMDA receptors by glutamate and other chemicals, helping improve memory, thinking, and the ability to perform daily tasks. It slows the progression of cognitive decline in Alzheimer's disease.

Take as prescribed by the doctor, usually starting at 5mg daily. Dose is gradually increased weekly as advised. Take with or without food, preferably at the same time each day. Do not stop medication abruptly without medical advice.

ADMENTA 10MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women. It is also not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

Inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver, or heart conditions. Avoid alcohol while on this medication. Report any unusual mood changes or severe side effects promptly. The common side effects are headache, dizziness, constipation, sleepiness, balance disorders.

How to use ADMENTA 10MG TABLET

Take as prescribed by the doctor, usually starting at 5mg daily. Dose is gradually increased weekly as advised. Take with or without food, preferably at the same time each day. Do not stop medication abruptly without medical advice.

Recommended dose and schedule

Start with 5 mg once daily, then gradually increase by 5 mg weekly to a usual maintenance dose of 10 mg once daily, or as prescribed by your doctor. Take the medication at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels.

Taking Admenta with or without food

Admenta 10mg Tablet can be taken with or without food. Consistency in timing is more important than food intake, so take it the same way every day.

More Information
Benefits of combining medication with mental exercises shown to enhance memory and attention.
Synergistic cognitive support: Medication regulates abnormal brain activity and slows neurodegeneration, while mental exercises stimulate neural pathways, promoting neuroplasticity and strengthening cognitive reserves.
Improved memory retention: Regular brain training activities help maintain and sometimes improve memory functions by reinforcing connections in areas affected by Alzheimer’s.
Enhanced attention and focus: Mental tasks can improve concentration and processing speed, complementing the medication's role in stabilizing cognitive function.
Slower cognitive decline: The combination may delay progression of symptoms more effectively than medication alone, improving quality of life.
Better daily functioning: Improved cognition supports the ability to perform everyday tasks independently for longer durations.
Increased patient engagement: Mental exercises offer active participation in care, fostering motivation, mood stabilization, and emotional well-being.
Customized and adaptive therapy: Digital cognitive tools can tailor exercises to patient's abilities, maximizing benefit alongside pharmacological treatment.

introduction:
Introduction About ADMENTA 5MG TABLET

Admenta 5mg Tablet: Detailed Overview

Admenta 5mg is used to manage moderate to severe Alzheimer’s disease. It supports memory, thinking, and cognitive function in Alzheimer's.

Alzheimer’s disease is a neurodegenerative disease that destroys memory and other important mental functions in an individual. It is caused due to formation and accumulation of certain toxic proteins in the brain that destroys brain cells. It can be characterized by loss of memory and forgetfulness of day-to-day activities.

Admenta 5mg Tablet contains Memantine, an NMDA receptor antagonist that helps regulate nerve signals in the brain involved in learning and memory. By modulating the activity of glutamate and other neurotransmitters, it helps maintain cognitive processes and mental clarity. This mechanism supports the management of conditions with memory and thinking difficulties over time.

Admenta 5mg Tablet should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women. It is also not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

Inform your doctor of any other medications or health conditions before starting Admenta 5mg Tablet. If dizziness, headache, or other side effects persist, consult your healthcare provider.
uses: Manage moderate to severe Alzheimer’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of ADMENTA 5MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe Alzheimer’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How ADMENTA 5MG TABLET Works

Admenta 5mg contains Memantine, an NMDA receptor antagonist that helps regulate nerve signals in the brain involved in learning and memory. By modulating the activity of glutamate and other neurotransmitters, it helps maintain cognitive processes and mental clarity. This mechanism supports the management of conditions with memory and thinking difficulties over time.

Why Admenta Supports Memory and Thinking?

Admenta 5mg supports memory and thinking primarily through its action as an NMDA (N-methyl-D-aspartate) receptor antagonist. It works by regulating glutamate, a key neurotransmitter involved in learning and memory, whose excessive levels can lead to neuronal damage and dysfunction in Alzheimer's disease. By blocking excessive glutamate activity at NMDA receptors, Admenta helps protect brain cells from excitotoxicity, a process that causes nerve cell damage and contributes to cognitive decline.

This selective regulation of glutamate activity helps restore a healthier balance of nerve signaling, slowing the progression of memory loss, confusion, and impaired thinking associated with Alzheimer's. It improves cognition by enhancing synaptic plasticity and reducing the abnormal overactivation of nerve cells, thus supporting better memory, focus, and mental function in patients with moderate to severe dementia. Although it does not cure Alzheimer's, Admenta helps reduce symptom deterioration and supports daily cognitive abilities.

introduction:
Introduction About DONEP 5MG TABLET

DONEP 5MG TABLET contains Donepezil which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinesterase inhibitors. DONEP 5MG TABLET is indicated for the management of mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia.

Alzheimer's disease is a brain disorder that causes dementia (a group of symptoms that affect the memory, thinking and social abilities of a person) by destroying the memory and other important mental functions in the brain which is characterized by memory loss, confusion, and behavioral changes.

Before taking DONEP 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are allergic to Donepezil, have asthma, heart, kidney, or liver disease.

DONEP 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking medicine.

DONEP 5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking DONEP 5MG TABLET.

The safety and effectiveness of DONEP 5MG TABLET in pediatric patients have not been established.

The most common side effects of taking DONEP 5MG TABLET are diarrhoea, feeling sick, tiredness, difficulty in sleeping, common cold, loss of appetite, hallucinations, and aggressive behaviour. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects get worse.
uses: Used to manage mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia
usesDetails:
Uses Of DONEP 5MG TABLET
Used to manage mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia
mechanismOfAction:
How DONEP 5MG TABLET Works

DONEP 5MG TABLET belongs to cholinesterase inhibitor which works by increasing the levels of a chemical messenger (acetylcholine) involved in transmission of nerve signals. This improves memory and thinking. Memory loss in Alzheimer’s disease occurs due to disturbances of signal transmission in the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use DONEP 5MG TABLET

Take DONEP 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow DONEP 5MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: DONEP 5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy unless it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking DONEP 5MG TABLET.
DONEP 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking DONEP 5MG TABLET.

DONEP 5MG TABLET may cause tiredness, dizziness and muscle cramp which could affect your ability to drive or operate machines. If you experience these side effects, do not drive or operate machines. Consult your doctor before taking DONEP 5MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DONEP 5MG TABLET because it may alter the effect of this medicine.
DONEP 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking DONEP 5MG TABLET.

DONEP 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems or hepatitis. Consult your doctor before taking DONEP 5MG TABLET.
Do not take DONEP 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Donepezil or piperidine derivatives such as haloperidol, thioridazine, or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
DONEP 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma or long-term lung disease. Consult your doctor before taking DONEP 5MG TABLET.

DONEP 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases such as irregular or very slow heartbeat, fast heartbeat, abnormal heart rhythms, family history of prolonged QT interval (fast and chaotic heartbeats), had heart failure, or heart attack. Consult your doctor before taking DONEP 5MG TABLET.

Others

Before taking DONEP 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:                                   

Have low levels of magnesium or potassium in your blood
Have difficulty passing urine
Have stomach or duodenal ulcers
Have seizures (fits) or convulsions

Use in pediatrics:

The safety and effectiveness of DONEP 5MG TABLET in pediatric patients have not been established. Consult your doctor before taking DONEP 5MG TABLET.

Use in geriatrics:

DONEP 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years above). Consult your doctor before taking DONEP 5MG TABLET.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking DONEP 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used for heart rhythm problems (Ex. amiodarone, sotalol)
Medicines used for depression (Ex. citalopram, escitalopram, amitriptyline, fluoxetine)
Medicines used for psychosis (Ex. pimozide, sertindole, ziprasidone)
Medicines used for bacterial infections (Ex. clarithromycin, erythromycin, levofloxacin, moxifloxacin, rifampicin)
Medicines used for fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole)
Other medicines used to manage Alzheimer’s disease (Ex. galantamine)
Medicines used for arthritis (Ex. aspirin, non-steroidal anti-inflammatory (NSAID) drugs such as ibuprofen, or diclofenac sodium)
Anticholinergics medicines (Ex. tolterodine)
Anticonvulsants (Ex. phenytoin, carbamazepine)
Medicines used to manage heart condition (Ex. quinidine, beta-blockers such as propanolol and atenolol)
Muscle relaxants (Ex. diazepam, succinylcholine)
General anesthetics (Ex. propofol, ketamine, thiopental)
Medicines obtained without a prescription (Ex. herbal remedies)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of DONEP 5MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are feeling and being sick, drooling, sweating, slow heart rate, low blood pressure (lightheadedness or dizziness when standing), breathing problems, losing consciousness and seizures (fits) or convulsions.

introduction:
Introduction About STROCIT PLUS TABLET

STROCIT PLUS TABLET is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

STROCIT PLUS TABLET can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking STROCIT PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

STROCIT PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with STROCIT PLUS TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking STROCIT PLUS TABLET are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.

mechanismOfAction:
How STROCIT PLUS TABLET Works

STROCIT PLUS TABLET contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, STROCIT PLUS TABLET repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.
usageDetails:
How to use STROCIT PLUS TABLET

Take STROCIT PLUS TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking STROCIT PLUS TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

Women of childbearing age must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with STROCIT PLUS TABLET.
STROCIT PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience drowsiness or shakiness after taking STROCIT PLUS TABLET.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with STROCIT PLUS TABLET.

STROCIT PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or ever had any severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

STROCIT PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take STROCIT PLUS TABLET if you are allergic to Citicoline or Piracetam.

Others

Have a previous history of bleeding in the brain

introduction:
Introduction About DONEP 10MG TABLET

DONEP 10MG TABLET contains Donepezil which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinesterase inhibitors. It is indicated for the management of mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia.

Alzheimer's disease is a brain disorder that causes dementia (a group of symptoms that affect the memory, thinking and social abilities of a person) by destroying the memory and other important mental functions in the brain which is characterized by memory loss, confusion, and behavioral changes.

Before taking DONEP 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are allergic to Donepezil, have asthma, heart, kidney, or liver disease.

DONEP 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking medicine.

DONEP 10MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking DONEP 10MG TABLET.

The safety and effectiveness of DONEP 10MG TABLET in pediatric patients have not been established.

The most common side effects of taking DONEP 10MG TABLET are diarrhoea, feeling sick, tiredness, difficulty in sleeping, common cold, loss of appetite, hallucinations, and aggressive behaviour. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects get worse.
uses: Used to manage mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia
usesDetails:
Uses Of DONEP 10MG TABLET
Used to manage mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia
mechanismOfAction:
How DONEP 10MG TABLET Works

DONEP 10MG TABLET belongs to cholinesterase inhibitor which works by increasing the levels of a chemical messenger (acetylcholine) involved in transmission of nerve signals. This improves memory and thinking. Memory loss in Alzheimer’s disease occurs due to disturbances of signal transmission in the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use DONEP 10MG TABLET

Take DONEP 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow DONEP 10MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CEHAM P TABLET

CEHAM P TABLET is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

CEHAM P TABLET can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking CEHAM P TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

CEHAM P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with CEHAM P TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking CEHAM P TABLET are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CEHAM P TABLET Works

CEHAM P TABLET contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, CEHAM P TABLET repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.

name: Strocit 500mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About STROCIT 500MG TABLET

STROCIT 500MG TABLET contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. STROCIT 500MG TABLET is used to manage cerebral insufficiency (such as dizziness, memory loss, poor circulation, disorientation) that occurs due to head trauma/brain injury in affected individuals.

STROCIT 500MG TABLET is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) and Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition) in affected individuals.

STROCIT 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking STROCIT 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery, and/or have persistent intracranial haemorrhage, kidney/liver disease.

STROCIT 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) if necessary. The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking STROCIT 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure, and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

STROCIT 500MG TABLET works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use STROCIT 500MG TABLET

Tablet:

Take STROCIT 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Orally Disintegrating Tablet:

Take STROCIT 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Place STROCIT 500MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ALZIL 10MG TABLET

ALZIL 10MG TABLET contains Donepezil which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinesterase inhibitors. It is indicated for the management of mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia.

Alzheimer's disease is a brain disorder that causes dementia (a group of symptoms that affect the memory, thinking and social abilities of a person) by destroying the memory and other important mental functions in the brain which is characterized by memory loss, confusion, and behavioral changes.

Before taking ALZIL 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are allergic to Donepezil, have asthma, heart, kidney, or liver disease.

ALZIL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking medicine.

ALZIL 10MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking ALZIL 10MG TABLET.

The safety and effectiveness of ALZIL 10MG TABLET in pediatric patients have not been established.

The most common side effects of taking ALZIL 10MG TABLET are diarrhoea, feeling sick, tiredness, difficulty in sleeping, common cold, loss of appetite, hallucinations, and aggressive behaviour. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects get worse.
uses: Used to manage mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia
usesDetails:
Uses Of ALZIL 10MG TABLET
Used to manage mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia
mechanismOfAction:
How ALZIL 10MG TABLET Works

ALZIL 10MG TABLET belongs to cholinesterase inhibitor which works by increasing the levels of a chemical messenger (acetylcholine) involved in transmission of nerve signals. This improves memory and thinking. Memory loss in Alzheimer’s disease occurs due to disturbances of signal transmission in the brain.

Take ALZIL 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow ALZIL 10MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

ALZIL 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma or long-term lung disease. Consult your doctor before taking ALZIL 10MG TABLET.

ALZIL 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases such as irregular or very slow heartbeat, fast heartbeat, abnormal heart rhythms, family history of prolonged QT interval (fast and chaotic heartbeats), had heart failure, or heart attack. The safety and effectiveness of ALZIL 10MG TABLET in pediatric patients have not been established. Consult your doctor before taking ALZIL 10MG TABLET.
ALZIL 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years above). Consult your doctor before taking ALZIL 10MG TABLET.

Others

Have difficulty passing urine
Have stomach or duodenal ulcers

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking ALZIL 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Anti-arrhythmics (Ex. amiodarone, sotalol)
Antidepressants (Ex. citalopram, escitalopram, amitriptyline, fluoxetine)
Antipsychotics (Ex. pimozide, sertindole, ziprasidone)
Antibiotics (Ex. clarithromycin, erythromycin, levofloxacin, moxifloxacin, rifampicin)
Anti-fungal agents (Ex. ketoconazole)
Other medicines used to manage Alzheimer’s disease (Ex. galantamine)
Medicines used for arthritis (Ex. aspirin, non-steroidal anti-inflammatory (NSAID) drugs such as ibuprofen, or diclofenac sodium)
Anticholinergics medicines (Ex. tolterodine)
Anticonvulsants (Ex. phenytoin, carbamazepine)
Cardiac drugs (Ex. quinidine, beta-blockers such as propanolol and atenolol)
Muscle relaxants (Ex. diazepam, succinylcholine)
General anesthetics (Ex. propofol, ketamine, thiopental)
Medicines obtained without a prescription (Ex. herbal remedies)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of ALZIL 10MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are feeling and being sick, drooling, sweating, slow heart rate, low blood pressure (lightheadedness or dizziness when standing), breathing problems, losing consciousness and seizures (fits) or convulsions.

introduction:
Introduction About NOOTROPIL C 500/800MG TABLET

NOOTROPIL C 500/800MG TABLET is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

NOOTROPIL C 500/800MG TABLET can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking NOOTROPIL C 500/800MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

NOOTROPIL C 500/800MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NOOTROPIL C 500/800MG TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking NOOTROPIL C 500/800MG TABLET are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.

mechanismOfAction:
How NOOTROPIL C 500/800MG TABLET Works

NOOTROPIL C 500/800MG TABLET contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, NOOTROPIL C 500/800MG TABLET repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.

Take NOOTROPIL C 500/800MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking NOOTROPIL C 500/800MG TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

name: Aricep 5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ARICEP 5MG TABLET

ARICEP 5MG TABLET contains Donepezil which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinesterase inhibitors. ARICEP 5MG TABLET is indicated for the management of mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia.

Alzheimer's disease is a brain disorder that causes dementia (a group of symptoms that affect the memory, thinking and social abilities of a person) by destroying the memory and other important mental functions in the brain which is characterized by memory loss, confusion, and behavioral changes.

Before taking ARICEP 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are allergic to Donepezil, have asthma, heart, kidney, or liver disease.

ARICEP 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking medicine.

ARICEP 5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 5MG TABLET.

The safety and effectiveness of ARICEP 5MG TABLET in pediatric patients have not been established.

The most common side effects of taking ARICEP 5MG TABLET are diarrhoea, feeling sick, tiredness, difficulty in sleeping, common cold, loss of appetite, hallucinations, and aggressive behaviour. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects get worse.
uses: Used to manage mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia
usesDetails:
Uses Of ARICEP 5MG TABLET
Used to manage mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia
mechanismOfAction:
How ARICEP 5MG TABLET Works

ARICEP 5MG TABLET belongs to cholinesterase inhibitor which works by increasing the levels of a chemical messenger (acetylcholine) involved in transmission of nerve signals. This improves memory and thinking. Memory loss in Alzheimer’s disease occurs due to disturbances of signal transmission in the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use ARICEP 5MG TABLET

Take ARICEP 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow ARICEP 5MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Uncontrollable or shaky movements with stiffness on the face and tongue which may also involve limbs

warnings.details: ARICEP 5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy unless it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 5MG TABLET.
ARICEP 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 5MG TABLET.

ARICEP 5MG TABLET may cause tiredness, dizziness and muscle cramp which could affect your ability to drive or operate machines. If you experience these side effects, do not drive or operate machines. Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 5MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ARICEP 5MG TABLET because it may alter the effect of this medicine.
ARICEP 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 5MG TABLET.

ARICEP 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems or hepatitis. Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 5MG TABLET.
Do not take ARICEP 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Donepezil or piperidine derivatives such as haloperidol, thioridazine, or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
ARICEP 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma or long-term lung disease. Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 5MG TABLET.

ARICEP 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases such as irregular or very slow heartbeat, fast heartbeat, abnormal heart rhythms, family history of prolonged QT interval (fast and chaotic heartbeats), had heart failure, or heart attack. Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 5MG TABLET.

Others

Before taking ARICEP 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:                                   

Have low levels of magnesium or potassium in your blood
Have difficulty passing urine
Have stomach or duodenal ulcers
Have seizures (fits) or convulsions

Use in pediatrics:

The safety and effectiveness of ARICEP 5MG TABLET in pediatric patients have not been established. Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 5MG TABLET.

Use in geriatrics:

ARICEP 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years above). Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 5MG TABLET.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking ARICEP 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used for heart rhythm problems (Ex. amiodarone, sotalol)
Medicines used for depression (Ex. citalopram, escitalopram, amitriptyline, fluoxetine)
Medicines used for psychosis (Ex. pimozide, sertindole, ziprasidone)
Medicines used for bacterial infections (Ex. clarithromycin, erythromycin, levofloxacin, moxifloxacin, rifampicin)
Medicines used for fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole)
Other medicines used to manage Alzheimer’s disease (Ex. galantamine)
Medicines used for arthritis (Ex. aspirin, non-steroidal anti-inflammatory (NSAID) drugs such as ibuprofen, or diclofenac sodium)
Anticholinergics medicines (Ex. tolterodine)
Anticonvulsants (Ex. phenytoin, carbamazepine)
Medicines used to manage heart condition (Ex. quinidine, beta-blockers such as propanolol and atenolol)
Muscle relaxants (Ex. diazepam, succinylcholine)
General anesthetics (Ex. propofol, ketamine, thiopental)
Medicines obtained without a prescription (Ex. herbal remedies)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of ARICEP 5MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are feeling and being sick, drooling, sweating, slow heart rate, low blood pressure (lightheadedness or dizziness when standing), breathing problems, losing consciousness and seizures (fits) or convulsions.

introduction:
Introduction About CITIMAC P TABLET

CITIMAC P TABLET is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

CITIMAC P TABLET can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking CITIMAC P TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

CITIMAC P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with CITIMAC P TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking CITIMAC P TABLET are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CITIMAC P TABLET Works

CITIMAC P TABLET contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, CITIMAC P TABLET repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.
usageDetails:
How to use CITIMAC P TABLET

Take CITIMAC P TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking CITIMAC P TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

Introduction About DONANCE 10 TABLET

DONANCE 10 TABLET contains Donepezil which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinesterase inhibitors. It is indicated for the management of mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia.

Alzheimer's disease is a brain disorder that causes dementia (a group of symptoms that affect the memory, thinking and social abilities of a person) by destroying the memory and other important mental functions in the brain which is characterized by memory loss, confusion, and behavioral changes.

Before taking DONANCE 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are allergic to Donepezil, have asthma, heart, kidney, or liver disease.

DONANCE 10 TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking medicine.

DONANCE 10 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking DONANCE 10 TABLET.

The safety and effectiveness of DONANCE 10 TABLET in pediatric patients have not been established.

The most common side effects of taking DONANCE 10 TABLET are diarrhoea, feeling sick, tiredness, difficulty in sleeping, common cold, loss of appetite, hallucinations, and aggressive behaviour. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects get worse.

DONANCE 10 TABLET belongs to cholinesterase inhibitor which works by increasing the levels of a chemical messenger (acetylcholine) involved in transmission of nerve signals. This improves memory and thinking. Memory loss in Alzheimer’s disease occurs due to disturbances of signal transmission in the brain.

introduction:
Introduction About LARENTINE 10MG TABLET

LARENTINE 10MG TABLET contains Memantine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-dementia drugs. It is used to manage moderate to severe Alzheimer’s disease. Alzheimer’s disease is a neurodegenerative disease that destroys memory and other important mental functions in an individual. It is caused due to formation and accumulation of certain toxic proteins in the brain that destroys brain cells. It can be characterized by loss of memory and forgetfulness of day-to-day activities.

Memantine is a N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor antagonist. It acts by blocking the over activation of certain chemicals (glutamate and beta-amyloid peptide) in the brain that causes Alzheimer’s disease. It can also block the activity of other chemical messengers (like serotonin and acetylcholine) which are responsible for affecting thoughts, memory and mental state.

Before taking LARENTINE 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or have a family history of fits or if you made any sudden changes to your diet. During management with LARENTINE 10MG TABLET, your doctor would closely monitor your health condition to access the improvement and to avoid unwanted side effects.

LARENTINE 10MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women. It is also not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking LARENTINE 10MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, sleepiness and constipation. Consult your doctor if they trouble you. Also, inform your doctor if you unusually feel sad or depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking LARENTINE 10MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About STORAX 500MG TABLET

STORAX 500MG TABLET contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. STORAX 500MG TABLET is used to manage cerebral insufficiency (such as dizziness, memory loss, poor circulation, disorientation) that occurs due to head trauma/brain injury in affected individuals.

STORAX 500MG TABLET is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) and Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition) in affected individuals.

STORAX 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking STORAX 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery, and/or have persistent intracranial haemorrhage, kidney/liver disease.

STORAX 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) if necessary. The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking STORAX 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure, and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How STORAX 500MG TABLET Works

STORAX 500MG TABLET works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.

Take STORAX 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Place STORAX 500MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NEMDAA 5MG TABLET

NEMDAA 5MG TABLET contains Memantine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-dementia drugs. It is used to manage moderate to severe Alzheimer’s disease. Alzheimer’s disease is a neurodegenerative disease that destroys memory and other important mental functions in an individual. It is caused due to formation and accumulation of certain toxic proteins in the brain that destroys brain cells. It can be characterized by loss of memory and forgetfulness of day-to-day activities.

Memantine is a N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor antagonist. It acts by blocking the over activation of certain chemicals (glutamate and beta-amyloid peptide) in the brain that causes Alzheimer’s disease. It can also block the activity of other chemical messengers (like serotonin and acetylcholine) which are responsible for affecting thoughts, memory and mental state.

Before taking NEMDAA 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or have a family history of fits or if you made any sudden changes to your diet. During management with NEMDAA 5MG TABLET, your doctor would closely monitor your health condition to access the improvement and to avoid unwanted side effects.

NEMDAA 5MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women. It is also not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NEMDAA 5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, sleepiness and constipation. Consult your doctor if they trouble you. Also, inform your doctor if you unusually feel sad or depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking NEMDAA 5MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About CITISTAR 500MG TABLET

CITISTAR 500MG TABLET contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. CITISTAR 500MG TABLET is used to manage cerebral insufficiency (such as dizziness, memory loss, poor circulation, disorientation) that occurs due to head trauma/brain injury in affected individuals.

CITISTAR 500MG TABLET is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) and Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition) in affected individuals.

CITISTAR 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking CITISTAR 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery, and/or have persistent intracranial haemorrhage, kidney/liver disease.

CITISTAR 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) if necessary. The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking CITISTAR 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure, and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How CITISTAR 500MG TABLET Works

CITISTAR 500MG TABLET works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.

Tablet:

Take CITISTAR 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Orally Disintegrating Tablet:

Take CITISTAR 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Place CITISTAR 500MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LARENTINE 5MG TABLET

LARENTINE 5MG TABLET contains Memantine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-dementia drugs. It is used to manage moderate to severe Alzheimer’s disease. Alzheimer’s disease is a neurodegenerative disease that destroys memory and other important mental functions in an individual. It is caused due to formation and accumulation of certain toxic proteins in the brain that destroys brain cells. It can be characterized by loss of memory and forgetfulness of day-to-day activities.

Memantine is a N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor antagonist. It acts by blocking the over activation of certain chemicals (glutamate and beta-amyloid peptide) in the brain that causes Alzheimer’s disease. It can also block the activity of other chemical messengers (like serotonin and acetylcholine) which are responsible for affecting thoughts, memory and mental state.

Before taking LARENTINE 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or have a family history of fits or if you made any sudden changes to your diet. During management with LARENTINE 5MG TABLET, your doctor would closely monitor your health condition to access the improvement and to avoid unwanted side effects.

LARENTINE 5MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women. It is also not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking LARENTINE 5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, sleepiness and constipation. Consult your doctor if they trouble you. Also, inform your doctor if you unusually feel sad or depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking LARENTINE 5MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About LAPEZIL 10MG TABLET

LAPEZIL 10MG TABLET contains Donepezil which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinesterase inhibitors. It is indicated for the management of mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia.

Alzheimer's disease is a brain disorder that causes dementia (a group of symptoms that affect the memory, thinking and social abilities of a person) by destroying the memory and other important mental functions in the brain which is characterized by memory loss, confusion, and behavioral changes.

Before taking LAPEZIL 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are allergic to Donepezil, have asthma, heart, kidney, or liver disease.

LAPEZIL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking medicine.

LAPEZIL 10MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking LAPEZIL 10MG TABLET.

The safety and effectiveness of LAPEZIL 10MG TABLET in pediatric patients have not been established.

The most common side effects of taking LAPEZIL 10MG TABLET are diarrhoea, feeling sick, tiredness, difficulty in sleeping, common cold, loss of appetite, hallucinations, and aggressive behaviour. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects get worse.

Used to manage mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia
mechanismOfAction:
How LAPEZIL 10MG TABLET Works

LAPEZIL 10MG TABLET belongs to cholinesterase inhibitor which works by increasing the levels of a chemical messenger (acetylcholine) involved in transmission of nerve signals. This improves memory and thinking. Memory loss in Alzheimer’s disease occurs due to disturbances of signal transmission in the brain.

How to use LAPEZIL 10MG TABLET

Take LAPEZIL 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow LAPEZIL 10MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CEHAM TABLET

CEHAM TABLET contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. CEHAM TABLET is used to manage cerebral insufficiency (such as dizziness, memory loss, poor circulation, disorientation) that occurs due to head trauma/brain injury in affected individuals.

CEHAM TABLET is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) and Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition) in affected individuals.

CEHAM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking CEHAM TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery, and/or have persistent intracranial haemorrhage, kidney/liver disease.

CEHAM TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) if necessary. The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking CEHAM TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure, and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How CEHAM TABLET Works

CEHAM TABLET works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use CEHAM TABLET

Tablet:

Take CEHAM TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Orally Disintegrating Tablet:

Take CEHAM TABLET as advised by your physician. Place CEHAM TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ALMERZIL 5MG TABLET

ALMERZIL 5MG TABLET contains Donepezil which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinesterase inhibitors. ALMERZIL 5MG TABLET is indicated for the management of mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia.

Alzheimer's disease is a brain disorder that causes dementia (a group of symptoms that affect the memory, thinking and social abilities of a person) by destroying the memory and other important mental functions in the brain which is characterized by memory loss, confusion, and behavioral changes.

Before taking ALMERZIL 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are allergic to Donepezil, have asthma, heart, kidney, or liver disease.

ALMERZIL 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking medicine.

ALMERZIL 5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking ALMERZIL 5MG TABLET.

The safety and effectiveness of ALMERZIL 5MG TABLET in pediatric patients have not been established.

The most common side effects of taking ALMERZIL 5MG TABLET are diarrhoea, feeling sick, tiredness, difficulty in sleeping, common cold, loss of appetite, hallucinations, and aggressive behaviour. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How ALMERZIL 5MG TABLET Works

ALMERZIL 5MG TABLET belongs to cholinesterase inhibitor which works by increasing the levels of a chemical messenger (acetylcholine) involved in transmission of nerve signals. This improves memory and thinking. Memory loss in Alzheimer’s disease occurs due to disturbances of signal transmission in the brain.

How to use ALMERZIL 5MG TABLET

Take ALMERZIL 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow ALMERZIL 5MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MENTAIMER 10 TABLET

MENTAIMER 10 TABLET contains Memantine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-dementia drugs. It is used to manage moderate to severe Alzheimer’s disease. Alzheimer’s disease is a neurodegenerative disease that destroys memory and other important mental functions in an individual. It is caused due to formation and accumulation of certain toxic proteins in the brain that destroys brain cells. It can be characterized by loss of memory and forgetfulness of day-to-day activities.

Memantine is a N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor antagonist. It acts by blocking the over activation of certain chemicals (glutamate and beta-amyloid peptide) in the brain that causes Alzheimer’s disease. It can also block the activity of other chemical messengers (like serotonin and acetylcholine) which are responsible for affecting thoughts, memory and mental state.

Before taking MENTAIMER 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or have a family history of fits or if you made any sudden changes to your diet. During management with MENTAIMER 10 TABLET, your doctor would closely monitor your health condition to access the improvement and to avoid unwanted side effects.

MENTAIMER 10 TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women. It is also not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking MENTAIMER 10 TABLET are headache, dizziness, sleepiness and constipation. Consult your doctor if they trouble you. Also, inform your doctor if you unusually feel sad or depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking MENTAIMER 10 TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About NEPZIL 10 TABLET

NEPZIL 10 TABLET contains Donepezil which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinesterase inhibitors. It is indicated for the management of mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia.

Alzheimer's disease is a brain disorder that causes dementia (a group of symptoms that affect the memory, thinking and social abilities of a person) by destroying the memory and other important mental functions in the brain which is characterized by memory loss, confusion, and behavioral changes.

Before taking NEPZIL 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are allergic to Donepezil, have asthma, heart, kidney, or liver disease.

NEPZIL 10 TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking medicine.

NEPZIL 10 TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking NEPZIL 10 TABLET.

The safety and effectiveness of NEPZIL 10 TABLET in pediatric patients have not been established.

The most common side effects of taking NEPZIL 10 TABLET are diarrhoea, feeling sick, tiredness, difficulty in sleeping, common cold, loss of appetite, hallucinations, and aggressive behaviour. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How NEPZIL 10 TABLET Works

NEPZIL 10 TABLET belongs to cholinesterase inhibitor which works by increasing the levels of a chemical messenger (acetylcholine) involved in transmission of nerve signals. This improves memory and thinking. Memory loss in Alzheimer’s disease occurs due to disturbances of signal transmission in the brain.

Take NEPZIL 10 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow NEPZIL 10 TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Colihenz Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About COLIHENZ INJECTION

COLIHENZ INJECTION contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. COLIHENZ INJECTION is used in adults to manage disturbances of consciousness that occurs due to head injuries, brain operation, and acute cerebral infraction.

COLIHENZ INJECTION is also used to manage Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and memory loss due to Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition). It is also indicated for use in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction (poor blood supply to the brain) in affected individuals. 

COLIHENZ INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity), persistent intracranial haemorrhages (bleeding inside the brain), and/or severe kidney disease.

Before receiving COLIHENZ INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have a history of epilepsy/fits, suffering from depression, scheduled for a surgery, and/or have liver disorders.

COLIHENZ INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary.

COLIHENZ INJECTION is advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if it is clearly necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving COLIHENZ INJECTION are diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, rash, insomnia (sleeplessness), and/or occurrence/intensification of numbness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How COLIHENZ INJECTION Works

COLIHENZ INJECTION works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use COLIHENZ INJECTION

COLIHENZ INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion or into a muscle as an intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Signs of shock (life threatening condition that occurs due to insufficient blood flow to the body) such as drop in blood pressure, distressed feeling of the chest, and/or shortness of breath

introduction:
Introduction About STROZINA PLUS

STROZINA PLUS is a combination of Citicoline and Piracetam which belongs to the group of medicines called Cerebroactive drugs. It is used as an adjunct for the management of acute stroke.

Acute stroke can be defined as a brain injury caused due to sudden loss in blood flow, nutrients and oxygen supply to the brain. It is usually characterized by paralysis of one side of the body, loss of sensation, double vision, difficulty in sleeping, facial droop, loss of balance, vertigo, nausea, vomiting, headache and/or blurred vision.

STROZINA PLUS can also be used to manage memory problems caused due to brain injury and other age-related brain problems.

Before taking STROZINA PLUS inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any bleeding problems, history of bleeding in the brain or parkinsonism.

STROZINA PLUS is not recommended for use in patients with Huntington Disease, intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding within the skull) or a previous history of depression. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with STROZINA PLUS.

The most common side effects of taking STROZINA PLUS are headache, constipation, diarrhea, difficulty in falling asleep, nervousness, dizziness and weight gain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.

mechanismOfAction:
How STROZINA PLUS Works

STROZINA PLUS contains two medicines namely citicoline and piracetam. Citicoline is a neuroprotectant. It protects the nerve cells by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as glutamate and other free radicals) within the brain and nervous system that damages the nerve cells.

Piracetam is a GABA analogue. It improves oxygen supply to the brain and nervous system and protects it from further injury. Collectively, STROZINA PLUS repairs the brain cells and regulates proper nerve signal transmissions across the brain and the nervous system.

introduction:
Introduction About NEUCITI 500MG TABLET

NEUCITI 500MG TABLET contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. NEUCITI 500MG TABLET is used to manage cerebral insufficiency (such as dizziness, memory loss, poor circulation, disorientation) that occurs due to head trauma/brain injury in affected individuals.

NEUCITI 500MG TABLET is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) and Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition) in affected individuals.

NEUCITI 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking NEUCITI 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery, and/or have persistent intracranial haemorrhage, kidney/liver disease.

NEUCITI 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) if necessary. The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking NEUCITI 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure, and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How NEUCITI 500MG TABLET Works

NEUCITI 500MG TABLET works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use NEUCITI 500MG TABLET

Tablet:

Take NEUCITI 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Orally Disintegrating Tablet:

Take NEUCITI 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Place NEUCITI 500MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Memantal 10mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MEMANTAL 10MG TABLET

MEMANTAL 10MG TABLET contains Memantine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-dementia drugs. It is used to manage moderate to severe Alzheimer’s disease. Alzheimer’s disease is a neurodegenerative disease that destroys memory and other important mental functions in an individual. It is caused due to formation and accumulation of certain toxic proteins in the brain that destroys brain cells. It can be characterized by loss of memory and forgetfulness of day-to-day activities.

Memantine is a N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor antagonist. It acts by blocking the over activation of certain chemicals (glutamate and beta-amyloid peptide) in the brain that causes Alzheimer’s disease. It can also block the activity of other chemical messengers (like serotonin and acetylcholine) which are responsible for affecting thoughts, memory and mental state.

Before taking MEMANTAL 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or have a family history of fits or if you made any sudden changes to your diet. During management with MEMANTAL 10MG TABLET, your doctor would closely monitor your health condition to access the improvement and to avoid unwanted side effects.

MEMANTAL 10MG TABLET should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women. It is also not suitable for use in children aged below 18 years. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking MEMANTAL 10MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, sleepiness and constipation. Consult your doctor if they trouble you. Also, inform your doctor if you unusually feel sad or depressed with suicidal thoughts after taking MEMANTAL 10MG TABLET.

Take MEMANTAL 10MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. It can be taken with or without meals.  Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take the medicine at the same time each day. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking MEMANTAL 10MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions

Before taking MEMANTAL 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Amantadine (a medicine used to manage viral infections or Parkinson’s disease)
Ketamine (a medicine used as an anesthetic)
Dextromethorphan (a medicine used to manage cough)
Medicine used to manage muscle spasms or spasticity (Ex. dantrolene, baclofen)
Medicine used to manage stomach ulcers (Ex. cimetidine, ranitidine)
Medicine used to manage abnormal heart rhythm (Ex. quinidine, procainamide, amiodarone, flecainide)
Medicine used to manage malaria (Ex. quinine)
Medicine used to increase urine output (Ex. hydrochlorothiazide)
Anticholinergics (used to manage movement disorders or intestinal cramps) such as atropine, scopolamine, glycopyrrolate
Medicine used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine, gabapentin)
Medicine used to induce sleep such as barbiturates (Ex. phenobarbital)
Medicines used in the management of mental disorders such as neuroleptics (Ex. thioridazine, chlorpromazine, thiothixene etc.)
Medicines used for blood clotting (Ex. warfarin, rivaroxaban)
Dopaminergic agonists (used to relieve conditions related to low levels of dopamine such as Parkinson's disease or restless legs syndrome) Ex. L-dopa, bromocriptine
Nicotine (a medicine used for smoking cessation)
Carbonic anhydrase inhibitors (used to increase urine output) Ex. acetazolamide

B. Drug - Food interactions

Consult your doctor if you have recently changed your diet (Ex. from normal diet to strict vegetarian diet) as there may be a need for dose adjustments.

Overdosage

If you or anyone else accidentally took more MEMANTAL 10MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose might include feeling tired, slow heart rate, confusion, dizziness, increased blood pressure, feeling faint, psychosis, feeling agitated, restless or sleepy, slowed movement, unsteady movements, hallucinations, sensation of spinning and vomiting.

name: Strocoz 500mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About STROCOZ 500MG TABLET

STROCOZ 500MG TABLET contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. STROCOZ 500MG TABLET is used to manage cerebral insufficiency (such as dizziness, memory loss, poor circulation, disorientation) that occurs due to head trauma/brain injury in affected individuals.

STROCOZ 500MG TABLET is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) and Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition) in affected individuals.

STROCOZ 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking STROCOZ 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery, and/or have persistent intracranial haemorrhage, kidney/liver disease.

STROCOZ 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) if necessary. The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking STROCOZ 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure, and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How STROCOZ 500MG TABLET Works

STROCOZ 500MG TABLET works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.
usageDetails:

Tablet:

Take STROCOZ 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Orally Disintegrating Tablet:

Take STROCOZ 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Place STROCOZ 500MG TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About STROCOZ 500MG SYRUP

STROCOZ 500MG SYRUP contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. STROCOZ 500MG SYRUP is used in adults to manage disturbances of consciousness that occurs due to head injuries, brain operation and acute cerebral infraction.

STROCOZ 500MG SYRUP is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) which is also used to manage Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition).

STROCOZ 500MG SYRUP is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking STROCOZ 500MG SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery and/or have kidney problems (such as renal insufficiency)/liver problems (such as hepatic insufficiency).

STROCOZ 500MG SYRUP should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking STROCOZ 500MG SYRUP are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How STROCOZ 500MG SYRUP Works

STROCOZ 500MG SYRUP works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.
