introduction:
Introduction About ARICEP 23 SR TABLET

ARICEP 23 SR TABLET contains Donepezil which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinesterase inhibitors. ARICEP 23 SR TABLET is indicated for the management of mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia.

Alzheimer's disease is a brain disorder that causes dementia (a group of symptoms that affect the memory, thinking and social abilities of a person) by destroying the memory and other important mental functions in the brain which is characterized by memory loss, confusion, and behavioral changes.

Before taking ARICEP 23 SR TABLET, inform your doctor if you are allergic to Donepezil, have asthma, heart, kidney, or liver disease.

ARICEP 23 SR TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking medicine.

ARICEP 23 SR TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 23 SR TABLET.

The safety and effectiveness of ARICEP 23 SR TABLET in pediatric patients have not been established.

The most common side effects of taking ARICEP 23 SR TABLET are diarrhoea, feeling sick, tiredness, difficulty in sleeping, common cold, loss of appetite, hallucinations, and aggressive behaviour. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects get worse.
uses: Used to manage mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia
usesDetails:

Used to manage mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia
mechanismOfAction:
How ARICEP 23 SR TABLET Works

ARICEP 23 SR TABLET belongs to cholinesterase inhibitor which works by increasing the levels of a chemical messenger (acetylcholine) involved in transmission of nerve signals. This improves memory and thinking. Memory loss in Alzheimer’s disease occurs due to disturbances of signal transmission in the brain.

How to use ARICEP 23 SR TABLET

Take ARICEP 23 SR TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow ARICEP 23 SR TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

ARICEP 23 SR TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 23 SR TABLET.

ARICEP 23 SR TABLET may cause tiredness, dizziness and muscle cramp which could affect your ability to drive or operate machines. If you experience these side effects, do not drive or operate machines. Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 23 SR TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ARICEP 23 SR TABLET because it may alter the effect of this medicine.
ARICEP 23 SR TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 23 SR TABLET.

ARICEP 23 SR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems or hepatitis. Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 23 SR TABLET.
Do not take ARICEP 23 SR TABLET if you are allergic to Donepezil or piperidine derivatives such as haloperidol, thioridazine, or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
ARICEP 23 SR TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma or long-term lung disease. Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 23 SR TABLET.

ARICEP 23 SR TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases such as irregular or very slow heartbeat, fast heartbeat, abnormal heart rhythms, family history of prolonged QT interval (fast and chaotic heartbeats), had heart failure, or heart attack. Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 23 SR TABLET.

Others

Before taking ARICEP 23 SR TABLET, inform your doctor if you:                                   

Have low levels of magnesium or potassium in your blood
Have difficulty passing urine
Have stomach or duodenal ulcers
Have seizures (fits) or convulsions

The safety and effectiveness of ARICEP 23 SR TABLET in pediatric patients have not been established. Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 23 SR TABLET.

Use in geriatrics:

ARICEP 23 SR TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years above). Consult your doctor before taking ARICEP 23 SR TABLET.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking ARICEP 23 SR TABLET, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used for heart rhythm problems (Ex. amiodarone, sotalol)
Medicines used for depression (Ex. citalopram, escitalopram, amitriptyline, fluoxetine)
Medicines used for psychosis (Ex. pimozide, sertindole, ziprasidone)
Medicines used for bacterial infections (Ex. clarithromycin, erythromycin, levofloxacin, moxifloxacin, rifampicin)
Medicines used for fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole)
Other medicines used to manage Alzheimer’s disease (Ex. galantamine)
Medicines used for arthritis (Ex. aspirin, non-steroidal anti-inflammatory (NSAID) drugs such as ibuprofen, or diclofenac sodium)
Anticholinergics medicines (Ex. tolterodine)
Anticonvulsants (Ex. phenytoin, carbamazepine)
Medicines used to manage heart condition (Ex. quinidine, beta-blockers such as propanolol and atenolol)
Muscle relaxants (Ex. diazepam, succinylcholine)
General anesthetics (Ex. propofol, ketamine, thiopental)
Medicines obtained without a prescription (Ex. herbal remedies)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of ARICEP 23 SR TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are feeling and being sick, drooling, sweating, slow heart rate, low blood pressure (lightheadedness or dizziness when standing), breathing problems, losing consciousness and seizures (fits) or convulsions.

introduction:
Introduction About COGNITRAC 60MG INJECTION

COGNITRAC 60MG INJECTION contains Cerebroprotein Hydrolysate which belongs to group of medicines called Neurotrophic agents. It is used to manage cranial injury, aprosexia (inability to concentrate) in dementia, cerebrovascular disease that includes stroke, and Alzheimer's disease.

A cranial injury is a head injury causing trauma to the scalp, skull, or brain. It is characterised by symptoms such as leakage of blood outside the blood vessels, uncontrolled bleeding, skull fracture, brain injury, or swelling in the brain.

A stroke occurs when the blood supply to the brain or part of it is blocked. It is characterised by symptoms such as troubled speech, numbness in the body, visual disturbances, headaches, and troubled waking.

Dementia is a group of symptoms such as loss of memory and thinking/reasoning abilities. Alzheimer’s disease is a disorder that causes progressive degeneration of brain cells, resulting in brain shrinkage. It is characterised by dementia, social withdrawal, and wandering.

COGNITRAC 60MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe renal dysfunction, status epilepticus (a life-threatening neurological disorder), or major epilepsia (a seizure that causes loss of consciousness and violent muscle contractions).

COGNITRAC 60MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with epilepsy (fits or seizures) and or allergic diathesis (condition causing predisposition to develop group of allergies such as hay fever, allergic rhinitis, bronchial asthma, or atopic dermatitis).

COGNITRAC 60MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding females only if it is clearly needed. COGNITRAC 60MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years). Consult your doctor before receiving it.

The common side effects associated with the use of COGNITRAC 60MG INJECTION are headache, nausea, vertigo (sensation of spinning), increased sweating, agitation, fever, and hallucinations. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage cerebrovascular disease that includes stroke (lack of blood supply in the brain)
Manage aprosexia (inability to concentrate) in dementia
Manage Alzheimer’s disease (disease caused due to degeneration of brain cells)

mechanismOfAction:
How COGNITRAC 60MG INJECTION Works

COGNITRAC 60MG INJECTION helps in restoring brain functions where Cerebroprotein Hydrolysate works by protecting nerve cells from toxins and lack of oxygen. It improves the survival ability of nerve cells. It also helps in the formation of new nerve cells, increasing nutrition of brain cells, reducing inflammation of brain tissues, and blocking the release of certain chemicals that may damage brain cells.

name: Donecept 10mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About DONECEPT 10MG TABLET

DONECEPT 10MG TABLET contains Donepezil which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinesterase inhibitors. It is indicated for the management of mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia.

Alzheimer's disease is a brain disorder that causes dementia (a group of symptoms that affect the memory, thinking and social abilities of a person) by destroying the memory and other important mental functions in the brain which is characterized by memory loss, confusion, and behavioral changes.

Before taking DONECEPT 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are allergic to Donepezil, have asthma, heart, kidney, or liver disease.

DONECEPT 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking medicine.

DONECEPT 10MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking DONECEPT 10MG TABLET.

The safety and effectiveness of DONECEPT 10MG TABLET in pediatric patients have not been established.

The most common side effects of taking DONECEPT 10MG TABLET are diarrhoea, feeling sick, tiredness, difficulty in sleeping, common cold, loss of appetite, hallucinations, and aggressive behaviour. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects get worse.
uses: Used to manage mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia
usesDetails:
Uses Of DONECEPT 10MG TABLET
Used to manage mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia
mechanismOfAction:
How DONECEPT 10MG TABLET Works

DONECEPT 10MG TABLET belongs to cholinesterase inhibitor which works by increasing the levels of a chemical messenger (acetylcholine) involved in transmission of nerve signals. This improves memory and thinking. Memory loss in Alzheimer’s disease occurs due to disturbances of signal transmission in the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use DONECEPT 10MG TABLET

Take DONECEPT 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow DONECEPT 10MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

General anesthetics (Ex. propofol, ketamine, thiopental)
Medicines obtained without a prescription (Ex. herbal remedies)

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of DONECEPT 10MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. name: CITINOL Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About CITINOL TABLET

CITINOL TABLET contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. CITINOL TABLET is used to manage cerebral insufficiency (such as dizziness, memory loss, poor circulation, disorientation) that occurs due to head trauma/brain injury in affected individuals.

CITINOL TABLET is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) and Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition) in affected individuals.

CITINOL TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking CITINOL TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery, and/or have persistent intracranial haemorrhage, kidney/liver disease.

CITINOL TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) if necessary. The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking CITINOL TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure, and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

Manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease and other cerebrovascular disease
Manage Parkinson’s disease
Helps in the acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction/ischemic stroke in affected individuals

Manage cerebral insufficiency that occurs due to head trauma/brain injury
Manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease and other cerebrovascular disease

mechanismOfAction:
How CITINOL TABLET Works

CITINOL TABLET works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.

Take CITINOL TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Take CITINOL TABLET as advised by your physician. Place CITINOL TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: CITIBEN 500 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About CITIBEN 500 TABLET

CITIBEN 500 TABLET contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. CITIBEN 500 TABLET is used to manage cerebral insufficiency (such as dizziness, memory loss, poor circulation, disorientation) that occurs due to head trauma/brain injury in affected individuals.

CITIBEN 500 TABLET is also used to manage cognitive dysfunction that occurs due to Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and other cerebrovascular disease. It is also indicated for use in acute and recovery phase of cerebral infarction (condition that occurs due to poor blood supply to the brain) and Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition) in affected individuals.

CITIBEN 500 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity).

Before taking CITIBEN 500 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for any surgery, and/or have persistent intracranial haemorrhage, kidney/liver disease.

CITIBEN 500 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) if necessary. The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking CITIBEN 500 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, headache, low blood pressure, and/or agitation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How CITIBEN 500 TABLET Works

CITIBEN 500 TABLET works by increasing the synthesis of phosphatidylcholine (chemical that produces acetylcholine, responsible for memory and other bodily functions) which leads to improved cerebral function and cognitive function in Alzheimer’s disease and Parkinson’s disease. It also works by repairing neuronal membranes and damaged cholinergic neurons via potentiation of acetylcholine production and reduction of free fatty acid accumulation at stroke-induced nerve damage site which results in the management neuronal cell death thus helping in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction in affected individuals.

Take CITIBEN 500 TABLET as advised by your physician. Place CITIBEN 500 TABLET inside your mouth and allow it to dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DONECEPT 5MG TABLET

DONECEPT 5MG TABLET contains Donepezil which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinesterase inhibitors. DONECEPT 5MG TABLET is indicated for the management of mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia.

Alzheimer's disease is a brain disorder that causes dementia (a group of symptoms that affect the memory, thinking and social abilities of a person) by destroying the memory and other important mental functions in the brain which is characterized by memory loss, confusion, and behavioral changes.

Before taking DONECEPT 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are allergic to Donepezil, have asthma, heart, kidney, or liver disease.

DONECEPT 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking medicine.

DONECEPT 5MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking DONECEPT 5MG TABLET.

The safety and effectiveness of DONECEPT 5MG TABLET in pediatric patients have not been established.

The most common side effects of taking DONECEPT 5MG TABLET are diarrhoea, feeling sick, tiredness, difficulty in sleeping, common cold, loss of appetite, hallucinations, and aggressive behaviour. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects get worse.
uses: Used to manage mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia
usesDetails:
Uses Of DONECEPT 5MG TABLET
Used to manage mild to moderately severe Alzheimer’s dementia
mechanismOfAction:
How DONECEPT 5MG TABLET Works

DONECEPT 5MG TABLET belongs to cholinesterase inhibitor which works by increasing the levels of a chemical messenger (acetylcholine) involved in transmission of nerve signals. This improves memory and thinking. Memory loss in Alzheimer’s disease occurs due to disturbances of signal transmission in the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use DONECEPT 5MG TABLET

Take DONECEPT 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow DONECEPT 5MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

DONECEPT 5MG TABLET may cause tiredness, dizziness and muscle cramp which could affect your ability to drive or operate machines. If you experience these side effects, do not drive or operate machines. Consult your doctor before taking DONECEPT 5MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DONECEPT 5MG TABLET because it may alter the effect of this medicine.
DONECEPT 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking DONECEPT 5MG TABLET.

Do not take DONECEPT 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Donepezil or piperidine derivatives such as haloperidol, thioridazine, or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
DONECEPT 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma or long-term lung disease. Consult your doctor before taking DONECEPT 5MG TABLET.

DONECEPT 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases such as irregular or very slow heartbeat, fast heartbeat, abnormal heart rhythms, family history of prolonged QT interval (fast and chaotic heartbeats), had heart failure, or heart attack. Consult your doctor before taking DONECEPT 5MG TABLET.

Others

Before taking DONECEPT 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:                                   

Have low levels of magnesium or potassium in your blood
Have difficulty passing urine
Have stomach or duodenal ulcers
Have seizures (fits) or convulsions

The safety and effectiveness of DONECEPT 5MG TABLET in pediatric patients have not been established. Consult your doctor before taking DONECEPT 5MG TABLET.

Use in geriatrics:

DONECEPT 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years above). Consult your doctor before taking DONECEPT 5MG TABLET.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking DONECEPT 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used for heart rhythm problems (Ex. amiodarone, sotalol)
Medicines used for depression (Ex. citalopram, escitalopram, amitriptyline, fluoxetine)
Medicines used for psychosis (Ex. pimozide, sertindole, ziprasidone)
Medicines used for bacterial infections (Ex. clarithromycin, erythromycin, levofloxacin, moxifloxacin, rifampicin)
Medicines used for fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole)
Other medicines used to manage Alzheimer’s disease (Ex. galantamine)
Medicines used for arthritis (Ex. aspirin, non-steroidal anti-inflammatory (NSAID) drugs such as ibuprofen, or diclofenac sodium)
Anticholinergics medicines (Ex. tolterodine)
Anticonvulsants (Ex. phenytoin, carbamazepine)
Medicines used to manage heart condition (Ex. quinidine, beta-blockers such as propanolol and atenolol)
Muscle relaxants (Ex. diazepam, succinylcholine)
General anesthetics (Ex. propofol, ketamine, thiopental)
Medicines obtained without a prescription (Ex. herbal remedies)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of DONECEPT 5MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are feeling and being sick, drooling, sweating, slow heart rate, low blood pressure (lightheadedness or dizziness when standing), breathing problems, losing consciousness and seizures (fits) or convulsions.

introduction:
Introduction About STORAX INJECTION

STORAX INJECTION contains Citicoline which belongs to a group of medicines called Psychostimulants. STORAX INJECTION is used in adults to manage disturbances of consciousness that occurs due to head injuries, brain operation, and acute cerebral infraction.

STORAX INJECTION is also used to manage Alzheimer’s disease (brain disease that affects memory and thinking skills) and memory loss due to Parkinson’s disease (age related degenerative brain condition). It is also indicated for use in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction (poor blood supply to the brain) in affected individuals. 

STORAX INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Citicoline. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from hypertonia (muscle overactivity), persistent intracranial haemorrhages (bleeding inside the brain), and/or severe kidney disease.

Before receiving STORAX INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have a history of epilepsy/fits, suffering from depression, scheduled for a surgery, and/or have liver disorders.

STORAX INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary.

STORAX INJECTION is advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if it is clearly necessary. It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving STORAX INJECTION are diarrhoea, nausea, stomach pain, rash, insomnia (sleeplessness), and/or occurrence/intensification of numbness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

STORAX INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before receiving STORAX INJECTION.
interactions:
Interactions

A.Drug - Drug interactions:

Before receiving STORAX INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are receiving any of the following medicine:

Levodopa, carbidopa, entacapone (medicines used to manage Parkinson’s disease)
Meclofenoxate (used as a dietary supplement to manage dementia)

Overdosage:

STORAX INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor or nurse if you experience any unusual symptoms.
